name: LED Off (Lito X1)
description: Turns off the aircraft arm LEDs on Lito X1. Lito X1 firmware names the parameter forearm_led_ctrl (hash 4e9115f3), not g_config.misc_cfg.forearm_lamp_ctrl (a259ceed) as in led_off.json. Written on the unwrapped FLYC inject port 40008, which coexists with DJI Fly. Confirmed on RC 2 + Lito X1 by lmdegreeds/dji_fcc_gpsoff (doc/DUSS-HARDWARE-FINDINGS.md, doc/PROTOCOL.md).

frames.note: FLYCONTROLLER write param by hash: forearm_led_ctrl = 0x00 (LED OFF)
